derivation: scripts/build_benchmark_data.py removed exactly these keys when building bar-gap-small and recorded them in benchmark/data/bar-gap-small/fixture.json. The expectation below restates the plant, so it does not depend on the quality checks being graded.

bars_validate.note: Reachable through data.validate with fail_on_gap and as_of, which the tool forwards. The report's own status arrives as data_status because the envelope's status field reports tool success.

common_failure_modes: Reporting the catalog summary as 'ready' without a bounded gap check.
Detecting the gap but still recommending the momentum run proceed unchanged.
Attributing the absence to suspension or holidays; rq.paused is false on every missing session.
Claiming rq.daily_factors is also broken; it deliberately retains those sessions.
Calling data.validate without fail_on_gap, which returns passed and hides the gap.
